difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled theorem at source lines 394-396 (book Theorem 4.3.2): for every map f the type of bi-invertibility structures on f is a mere proposition. The statement is again a propositionality claim, and the proof (source lines 397-400) reduces it to contractibility under an assumed structure, then has to notice that bi-invertibility yields a quasi-inverse, which is the hypothesis needed to apply the contractibility of both inverse types, after which the product case for contractible types finishes the job. The detour through the quasi-inverse is the content and it is invisible in the statement.
